200565.overview:
The game features a campaign starring Shadow Yamoto, one of the protagonists of Eternal Champions. It has several different features including: 

* Alternative secret paths
* 4 endings in the main campaign
* 3 endings for extra modes
* 3 unlockable modes
* 5 unlockable characters

The game also features a rudimentary level up system, allowing the player to gain HP and MP, along with learning new combos and special skills.

Source: https://sergiokrauser3.blogspot.com

206420.overview: Evil Dead is a side-scrolling beat 'em up using OpenBOR, created by Thatcher Productions in 2021. Control Ash as he hacks and slashes his way through deadites galore. Developer Andrew Thatcher explained that this was the first game he ever made, and called the November 2021 update the "definitive redux version", overhauling the original.

216844.overview:
Enter Double Dragon AKA Double Dragon: Enter Evil Forces Expand is a game created in 2013. However, it is one of the best works for OpenBoR that simulates 8-bit systems. The graphics and animation are very reminiscent of the old Nintendo consoles.Simple decorations, which, however, look great in the overall look. 

  Enter Double Dragon AKA Double Dragon: Enter Evil Forces Expand  uses the OpenBoR engine to power its models, which means that the dynamics and gameplay are modern and attractive. The figures move at a game pace that will allow you to immerse yourself in this beat 'em up world. At your disposal are three characters to play with. You can choose Billy Lee, Jimmy Lee or Bimmy, who is a new character for the saga. The three characters have similar techniques for fighting. Particularly attractive is Jimmy, who has some pretty spectacular grips.

  The game looks very good and the synchronization between the elements is excellent, the dynamics are high quality and the matches are fascinating. We can mention that it is quite short and you will want to play more.

  Two more levels have been added to the game, probably a demo for the next fuller version. They are quite interesting and completely new plots.

  Enter Double Dragon AKA Double Dragon: Enter Evil Forces Expand the game  has been produced by OpenBoR society and Die in Fire

447859.overview:
Story: You has fallen into an underground caves. You need to find upgrades in order to access new areas and finally escape from the caves. These caves are scary and you can't help but feel that someone or something is watching you.

Controls:
NumPad keys = move Vimena and aim shots.
Z = Jump.
X = Shoot (can aim and shoot in 8 directions).
C = Interact.
Enter = Pause or confirm.
F8 = Take a screenshot.

Features:
- Continuous shooting by holding shoot button.
- 8 directional shooting.
- Health upgrades.
- Secrets.

453145.overview: Murdered by criminals, Detective Yokoda's body is retrieved by Professor Tani and taken to his laboratory. There, Tani performs an experiment that has failed seven times, Yokoda is the eighth subject to have his life force transferred into an body. For the first time, the experiment succeeds. Yokoda is reborn as the armour skinned android 8 Man the cyborg superhero who fights against an invading evil robot army.
